aim: Add independent Chicago Fed NFCI and ANFCI financial condition historical as-of vintages to exactly the same 138 historically fully observed BTC weekly nonexpansion cases from BTCI v8.12.
secret: FRED_API_KEY from GitHub Actions; never log secret or URL containing it, never write to R2 or report
publication: For each SUNDAY t in frozen 138-week cohort, query realtime_start=realtime_end=t for both NFCI, ANFCI. Require latest available weekly reference observation date <= t - 6 calendar days (original reference Friday, published subsequent Wednesday). Do not use any data published after Sunday; intraday release clock not documented, but Sundays after official weekday release are conservative.
dataWindow: Request 16 calendar weeks before t through Sunday t to obtain most recent weekly index and a reference index >=27 and <=35 days earlier. Need at least five observations and last is <=t-6 days. latest data missing >18 calendar days => UNKNOWN not forward filled.

indicators.NFCI_IMPROVE4: NFCI last as-of-vintage observation minus value four weekly observations before is <0; lower index = easing condition
indicators.ANFCI_IMPROVE4: ANFCI last as-of-vintage observation minus value four weekly observations before is <0
indicators.NFCI_EASY_LEVEL: NFCI current as-of-vintage last index <0 (easier than its historical norm, not proof of expansion)
indicators.NFCI_AND_FED: NFCI_IMPROVE4 AND v8.12 independent Fed H4.1 proxy UP

comparators: Use existing FRED H4.1 independent warning C and previous weekly BTC A on exactly same frozen rows, plus new conditions. No training and no fitted threshold.
outcomes: Use frozen v8.12 labels: new 52w structural expansion within 13w; BTC reference return >0 in 13 weeks; daily-close drawdown <=-20% in 13 weeks. Not an externally labelled true economic bull/bear cycle.
metrics: Identical-case confusion matrices, selected count and false positives, recall, median13w returns, 20% adverse path rate, 2020-23 vs 2024-26, fixed every13th eligible anchor; leading 13w before six structural expansions; first warning episode from continuous eligible Sundays. Report missingness separately.
quality: Exact 138 frozen dates, input parent SHA match, each official vintage response raw SHA, observation realtime_start<=Sunday<=realtime_end, no future observation, latest release reference lag, only returned as-of vintage data accepted.
archive: One R2 JSONL archive per series containing exact raw per-date JSON body and SHA256 + audited derived index observations; final full report JSON, manifest R2 readback, unique run prefix. Missing API requests mark UNKNOWN, never substitute current non-vintage series.
pit_caveat: FRED as-of date returns historical release vintage for the given date but exact publication times within days not verified; weekend query cuts off only previous published records. No realtime trading.
uncertainty: Research selection already shaped by viewed historical outcomes; no independent holdout, 138 overlapping weeks and 6 structural transitions are dependent. No model approval or calibrated prediction from this research.
operational: Do not change Futures, Spot, NAV, P&L, reserve, capital, MASTER, risk limits, or live Detector
